**Preview:** not needed, documentation only.

## What and why

The weekly spec watch found that [The Website Specification](https://specification.website) checklist changed. The diff of `docs/spec-checklist.md` shows which requirements were added, removed or changed level.

## Before merging

- [ ] Read the diff and open the changed requirements on specification.website
- [ ] Update `docs/website-spec.md` in this pull request for every requirement that affects the site (new Required or Recommended items, changed levels)
- [ ] Add follow up work to `docs/roadmap.md` where needed
- [ ] Add or adjust conformance tests if a changed requirement is already tested

This pull request was opened by `.github/workflows/spec-watch.yml`. CI does not run on it automatically; push a commit to trigger it.
